title: OSCQR Rubric Item Registry
description: Registry of OSCQR rubric items consumed by lib.validators.oscqr.OSCQRValidator. W-D7 T7.7 mints this externalized registry; the validator continues to dispatch via in-class _check_* methods (full registry-driven dispatch deferred).

item_id.description: Canonical OSCQR rubric item identifier (e.g. OV-1, CLA-3).

check_function.description: Python attribute name on lib.validators._oscqr_items.checks_<category>. Resolved via importlib at validator load when the registry-driven dispatcher lands.

calibration_thresholds.description: Per-item numeric tuning knobs (e.g. min_words_per_page, min_unique_module_titles).
